resume: After a separation: insure the new home before you get the keys, notify the old home's insurer within 15 days, cancel at no cost and check that the children remain covered.
aQuoiCaSert: When you leave the family home, you need to deal with the old home insurance (assurance habitation) contract and to insure the new home. A tenant must at least be insured against tenant's risks (risques locatifs); otherwise the landlord can ask for the lease to be terminated or take out insurance in the tenant's place and charge it back to them. It is also the right time to check your civil liability cover (responsabilité civile), often included in the home insurance contract, which covers damage caused by the children.
quiEstConcerne: The parent who moves after a separation, whether a tenant or an owner.
The parent who stays in the home and needs to adapt the contract.
Both parents, to make sure the children have civil liability cover at each parent's home.
aSavoir: Tenant: only insurance against tenant's risks (fire, explosion, water damage) is compulsory. Give the certificate to the landlord when you get the keys, then every year if they ask for it.

Without insurance, after a registered letter that has had no effect for one month, the landlord can insure the home for you and charge you the premium, plus up to 10%. They can also take steps to terminate the lease.
Moving: notify your insurer before you leave, or at the latest 15 calendar days after leaving the home, by registered letter on paper or by registered electronic mail.

Cancellation because of a move: possible if the change of home alters the insured risks. The letter can be sent before or after you leave, no later than 3 months after. The contract ends 1 month after the insurer receives it.
No cancellation fee can be charged because of a move, and premiums paid for the period after cancellation must be refunded to you.
You can also transfer the contract to the new home if the insurer agrees, by amendment (avenant); the premium may then change.

documents.libelle: Current home insurance contract and contract number
documents.detail: To know the cover, the names of the insured and the cancellation terms.

documents.libelle: Lease or move-in inspection report (état des lieux) for the new home
documents.detail: Copy. The insurer will ask for the address, floor area and number of rooms.

documents.libelle: Insurance certificate for the new home
documents.detail: To give to the landlord on the day you get the keys.

documents.libelle: Cancellation or notification letter to the former insurer
documents.detail: State the date you left and the link with the move. Send by registered mail.

documents.libelle: Proof of the date you left
documents.detail: For example the move-out inspection report or the new lease. The official page does not require a specific document: the insurer may ask for one.
It starts the one-month period before the contract ends.

etapes.titre: Insure the new home before you get the keys
etapes.detail: The landlord will ask for the certificate on move-in day.
For moving in: insurance certificate, ID, signed lease. For the insurer: contract number, new address, floor area, move-in date.
Before leaving or within the following 15 days. Cancel no later than 3 months after leaving if you wish.
Check with the insurer how to remove a name or take out a new contract, so the parent who stays is properly covered.

etapes.titre: Check the children's civil liability cover
etapes.detail: Make sure the children remain covered when they are at your home, under your contract or the other parent's, and share the certificates.
Store the letter and the acknowledgment of receipt in the Vault.
